## Triage: first touch → p2 (confirmed) · theme: performance and security (roll-up correctness) · 2026-11-17T00:33Z

⛔ Not a claim.

A predicate update (`multi: true`) resolves the parent once for the whole matched set, so a validation rule that reads a parent roll-up answers differently than it would one row at a time. This follows the #33795 ruling B (「被规则读到的合计不延后」). A rule can admit or refuse wrongly, but only on bulk writes, read from code: **p2**, confirmed. Area o2-E takes it after #34439.
